## Stage R5-gate: does an arm match the rules on feeding? (the registered rule)

An arm matches if (1) the paired interval of energy eaten, arm minus rules, includes 0 and the mean difference is within 5% of the rules' mean; (2) it has no fewer nights in a nest than the rules less one and the paired interval of the share of nights is not wholly below 0; (3) the size of its mean distance difference is no more than the rules' spread across animals (0.82 km here). "Weakly": the energy interval is wider than the 5% it is judged against, so it cannot tell a match from a 5% shortfall.
